Now I see the fuzz target. It uses `cs_insn_name(handle, i->id)` which calls `TMS320C64x_insn_name`. The vulnerability is that `insn_name_maps` is a small array (only ADD and NOP defined), but `TMS320C64X_INS_ENDING` is a large value (the last enum entry). So if the disassembler returns an instruction with an ID between the size of `insn_name_maps` and `TMS320C64X_INS_ENDING`, it will read out of bounds.
